The experience

Whether you're a world brewing champion or a brewing beginner, Stagg EKG will be your countertop partner in the pursuit of a ridiculously good cup of coffee. With variable temperature control, 1200 watts for a quick heat time, and a world of features for ultimate control, this is the pour-over kettle perfected.

Details

Dimensions (LxWxH): 11.10 in (282 mm) x 6.77 in (172 mm) x 7.7 in (196 mm)

Weight: 1,400 g (includes kettle base)

Capacity: 30 oz (0.9 L)

Cord length: 2.5 ft (76.2 cm)

Plug: Type-B (for U.S. and Canada)

Power: 110-120V~ / 1000-1200W / 50-60Hz

Materials: 304 18/8 stainless steel, BPA-free plastic handle and lid pull, optional wooden handle and lid pull in walnut or maple

Studio Edition Materials: Glass and metal touch points

Temperature range: 104°F-212°F / 40°C-100°C

Product certifications: ETL compliance, FCC certified, CSA certified, UL compliance

Warnings:CA Prop 65

Features

A high-resolution, full-color screen unlocks a suite of precision features, giving you total control over every cup.

Schedule: Set your kettle to heat to a specific temperature exactly when you need it.

Guide Mode: Not sure where to start? Select preset temperatures for various coffee brewing methods and tea types.

Brew Stopwatch: Stay on track with a built-in timer for pour-over and steeping, so every brew is just right.

Altitude: Prevent boiling over by customizing the elevation for your location.

Adjustable Hold Mode: Keep water hot for 15, 30, 45, or 60 minutes—your choice.

Chime + volume control: Turn the chime on or off, and adjust the volume to your liking.

Units: Choose between Fahrenheit and Celsius.

Pre-boil: Boil at max temperature to sanitize before cooling to your set temperature.

Language: Select from English, French, or Spanish.

Clock: Switch between analog or digital time displays.

Stay up to date: Get the latest firmware through WiFi updates using the EKG Updater app. Note: The app does not currently support remote control of your kettle or its settings.

How it works

Precision in every detail

To-the-degree temperature control

Set your target temperature and Stagg EKG Pro maintains it precisely.

A powerful heating system brings water up to temperature quickly and keeps it stable while you pour.

Scheduling

Set your kettle to heat in advance so hot water is ready when you are.

Simple control interface

An intuitive dial and clear display make it easy to adjust settings and start heating without overthinking the process.

Take a closer look

A pleasure to hold

An ergonomic handle that feels natural in your hand and stays comfortable from the first pour to the last.

Clear at a glance

A high-resolution color display shows temperature and heating progress so you always know where things stand.

Pour like a pro

A precision pour spout supports a slow, controlled flow for accurate pouring and even saturation.

Pour out all the stops

What is Studio Edition?

Thoughtfully crafted with premium materials, Studio Edition features a reflective glass base and refined metal accents. Designed to stand out on the counter while delivering the same precision performance you expect from Stagg EKG Pro.

Learn More

How do I use and care for my EKG Pro or Pro Studio Edition?

Stagg EKG Pro Safety Manual 

EKG Pro & Pro Studio Menu Walkthrough

Get-to-Know-You Guide

Is the Stagg EKG Pro or Pro Studio Edition Electric Kettle stovetop safe?

No. Please do not use your electric kettle on your stovetop! The kettle is designed for use with its electric base ONLY. By putting the kettle on your stovetop or induction surface, you risk melting functional parts in the kettle and paint.

If you're looking for a pour-over kettle that's stovetop safe, please check out our stovetop kettles.

How do I register my Stagg EKG Pro or Pro Studio Edition kettle?

In order to register your Fellow electric product please submit this form. After registering, you will receive an email from Fellow containing your registration perks like priority support! Please save this email for future reference. 

If you run into any difficulty when registering or you would like to check the status of your perks please contact us – we’re happy to help. 

Registration is only eligible for products purchased in the United States on or after June 29, 2021.

Can I heat milk or other liquids in my Fellow electric kettle?

The Fellow line of electric kettles was designed to be an incredibly efficient water heater/boiler. The software and hardware are crafted to be sure you have the best experience possible with water only. Even if it is set at a lower temperature, the heating cycle is so rapid it could scald milk and other liquids. Please don't use the EKG with milk or any liquid other than fresh, clean water. Doing so will void your warranty.

What does the EKG Updater app do and why do I need it?

Although it’s not needed to use the product, we will occasionally provide updates to the firmware in your Stagg EKG Pro / Corvo EKG Pro or Pro Studio Edition to ensure everything is running optimally and that your kettle has the latest firmware. Choosing not to use the app will not diminish the usefulness of your kettle, as the updates are not needed for the Pro or Pro Studio Edition to work.

Please note: you aren’t able to control your kettle or its settings via the EKG Updater app at this time. The app is also not compatible with Stagg EKG+ kettles.

What are the differences between the Stagg EKG Pro and Stagg EKG Pro Studio Edition?

To see a detailed comparison across all of our electric kettles please visit this page.
